analysis.mood: Golden hour glow: sun-kissed, peachy-bronze, and glossy like you live in a perpetual sunset

steps.technique: Start with a hydrating toner or essence pressed into skin, then layer a lightweight serum and a moisturizer. Finish with a glow-boosting primer on the high points of the face and a bit of body shimmer oil on the collarbones.
tips: Let each layer sink in so the base doesn't pill
Lip mask or balm first so the gloss glides on smoothly
Keep prep light so the skin looks juicy and not greasy

steps.technique: Apply a sheer-to-medium skin tint or serum foundation with a damp sponge, then dab concealer only where needed. Warm up the cheekbones, temples, and nose bridge with cream bronzer, and tap liquid highlighter on the high points for a lit-from-within shine.
tips: Skip heavy powder, just set the T-zone lightly
Match bronzer to the neck and chest so it blends in
Keep the nose and cheekbones glowy for that sunlit look

steps.technique: Wash a warm peach-copper shade across the lid and blend it up and out toward the outer brow bone. Press gold shimmer onto the center of the lid with a finger for a foiled effect. Smudge brown liner along the upper lash line and the outer corner for soft definition, then add fluttery lashes.
tips: Blend edges well so the color looks like a soft sunset gradient
Pat shimmer on instead of sweeping to avoid fallout
Keep the inner corner bright to open up the eyes
Brush brows up and soft for a fluffy, natural frame
productHints: volumizing mascara or wispy false lashes

steps.technique: Tap cream or liquid blush onto the apples of the cheeks and blend it up toward the temples for a lifted, flushed look. Diffuse the edges with a sponge or fingers so it melts into the skin.
tips: Build in thin layers so it stays sheer and natural
Bring a touch of blush over the nose bridge for a sun-kissed vibe
Apply blush before powder so it stays glowy
productHints: fluffy blush brush or damp sponge

steps.technique: Line the lips with a warm caramel pencil and softly smudge it inward for a blurred, slightly deeper edge. Fill in with a peachy-nude lip color, then top the center with a high-shine gloss to make the lips look plump.
tips: Keep the liner close to your natural lip shape for a subtle plump
Add gloss mainly to the center of the lips for dimension
Blot the liner a bit so the color stays soft and not harsh

analysis.mood: Soft pink doll-core glow: dewy, sweet, and blushy like you just came in from the cold

steps.technique: Layer a hydrating toner or essence, then a lightweight serum, and seal with a gel-cream moisturizer. Finish with a thin glow-boosting facial oil or sheen mist on high points so the skin looks juicy but not greasy.
tips: Let each layer sink in for about a minute so base doesn't pill
Skip heavy mattifying primers, since this look needs bounce
Add lip balm and under-eye cream for smooth, hydrated texture

steps.technique: Apply a thin layer of sheer skin tint or light-coverage fluid foundation with fingers or a damp sponge, pressing it in. Spot-conceal only where needed, then tap a liquid or cream highlighter on the nose bridge, nose tip, cheekbones, and forehead center for a glassy sheen.
tips: Keep coverage sheer so the natural skin texture and flush show through
Powder only the T-zone lightly, or skip it entirely
Warm the product in your fingers for a seamless melt

steps.technique: Sweep a pink-coral cream or powder shadow across the lid and slightly under the eyes, diffusing it out for a flushed, just-cried look. Dab a little shimmer on the center of the lid and inner corner. Add a thin, soft brown liner at the lash line and curl lashes, then coat with separated mascara, including the bottom lashes for that doll-like fringe.
tips: Blend the edges until there are no harsh lines
Keep the pink sheer, since the look is a flush and not a full color pop
Comb through bottom lashes so they stay wispy, not clumpy

steps.technique: Tap a cream or liquid blush onto the apples of the cheeks and blend up and out toward the temples in a rounded shape. Diffuse the edges with fingers until it melts into skin, and layer a little across the nose bridge for a sun-kissed, flushed vibe.
tips: Build it in thin layers so it stays airy and not patchy
Apply blush before any powder so it keeps that glow
Echo the same pink on the eyes and lips to tie it all together

steps.technique: Dab a watery lip tint in the center of the lips and pat outward with a finger for a blurred gradient, leaving the edges soft pink. Add a clear or lightly tinted gloss on the center of the lips for a plump, glassy finish.
tips: Keep the outer edge diffused, with no sharp liner
Build the color slowly, starting from the inner lips
Blot lightly before gloss for a longer-lasting stain

analysis.mood: Main-pop-star-under-neon-lights: glossy, berry-pink, and unapologetically glam

steps.technique: Layer a hydrating toner or essence, then a lightweight serum, and seal with a gel-cream moisturizer. Finish with a thin hydrating primer or facial oil on the high points so skin looks plump and lit from within.
tips: Let each layer sink in so base doesn't pill
Skip heavy oils on the T-zone if you get shiny fast
Add a cooling eye cream to de-puff before glam

steps.finish: luminous, skin-like satin with glossy highlights
steps.technique: Press a thin layer of light-coverage foundation or skin tint with a damp sponge, concealing only where needed. Tap liquid or cream highlighter on cheekbones, nose bridge, and cupid's bow for that wet-look shine. Set only the edges of the T-zone lightly.
tips: Keep coverage sheer so skin texture still looks real
Press, don't swipe, to keep the glow intact
Blend base down the neck so it matches

steps.technique: Sweep a pink matte or satin shade across the lid and up toward the brow bone in a soft halo. Pat a shimmery pink or glitter topper on the center of the lid for dimension, and add a deeper orchid shade at the outer corner. Draw a thin winged liner and finish with lashes and a touch of lower lash definition.
tips: Use a fluffy brush to blend edges so the wash looks airbrushed
Press glitter on with a finger or flat brush to avoid fallout
Keep the brows soft and natural so the eyes stay the star

steps.technique: Dab cream or liquid blush on the apples and blend it up and out toward the temples, then over the nose bridge for a sun-flushed look. Layer a little more on the apples for a punchy, doll-like effect.
tips: Build in thin layers so it stays blended and not patchy
Apply blush before powder to keep it glowy
Match the blush tone to your lips and eyes so the look feels cohesive

steps.technique: Line the lips with a berry pencil and fill in with a pigmented lip color. Press a clear or tinted plumping gloss over the center of the lips for a mirror-like pop. Blur the edges slightly for a soft stained look.
tips: Exfoliate and balm lips first so the color goes on smooth
Dab gloss at the center only to prevent feathering
Choose a liner just a shade deeper than your lip color
